pages.title: Maldito Botín
pages.creator: TSS SOFTWARE MEDIA (TSM)
pages.description: Help Captain Nico win back his ship in Maldito Botín. Fight your way across ten cursed islands and take on their bosses. Experiment with weapon pairings such as ice and a shotgun, build bridges and cannons from scrap, and spend time between voyages recruiting crew or upgrading the ship.

pages.title: Arrow Puzzle
pages.creator: Yizhiyuan Network Technology Co., Ltd.
pages.description: Clear the board in Arrow Puzzle by tapping arrows that have an open path. Look at the direction of each piece before choosing one. Every arrow that leaves opens more room, so find a sequence that lets the blocked pieces escape too.

pages.title: Draw Bridge Puzzle
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Draw a bridge to carry a vehicle across a gap in Draw Bridge Puzzle. Look at the broken road and nearby hazards before tracing a line. Choose where the bridge starts and ends so the vehicle can cross it and reach the goal.

pages.title: Drunk But Not Wasted Knight
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Meet a tipsy knight in a moonlit alley in Drunk But Not Wasted Knight. Talk your way through the medieval visual novel and decide how to respond as the conversation takes unexpected turns. Your choices affect the relationship and can lead to different endings.

pages.title: Basketball Stars 2026
pages.creator: MadPuffers
pages.description: Choose a team and play for the tournament in Basketball Stars 2026. Go for dunks or three-pointers, block shots, and try to take the ball when your opponent leaves an opening. Watch the supershot meter and use the special dunk once it fills.

pages.title: Pesky Moles
pages.creator: Oblocze LLC
pages.description: Keep moles out of the vegetable patch in Pesky Moles. Stop as many as you can before the round ends and earn coins for the crops you save. Use those coins to buy traps that help defend the garden during the next round.

pages.title: Chinese Food Chef DuDu
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Cook traditional dishes for a little monkey in Chinese Food Chef DuDu. Pick a recipe and work through the preparation steps for dishes such as dumplings and zongzi. Try another recipe to see how its ingredients come together differently.

pages.title: Snowboard Game​ Party
pages.creator: Online Games
pages.description: Race other riders down snowy courses in Snowboard Game Party. Keep your speed up while steering around fences and snowballs or adjusting for a sudden slope. Win races to earn points, then unlock gear and change your rider's look.

pages.title: Obstacle Car Driving
pages.creator: Abdul Wakil Mondal
pages.description: Steer around obstacles and collect currency in Obstacle Car Driving. The endless courses span four environments, and the four cars handle differently. Use what you earn on the road to unlock more vehicles and themes for future runs.

pages.title: Unicycle Balance 3D
pages.creator: GameBiz
pages.description: Keep a rider upright on one wheel in Unicycle Balance 3D. Correct your balance while pedaling over uneven terrain and past obstacles. Watch how the rider leans and adjust early so you can stay on the unicycle through the next stretch.

pages.title: House Robber
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Sneak into houses, grab the goods, and get back out in House Robber. Check where the security guard is before you cross a room or head for the exit. Each level changes the layout, so look for a new route as you go.

pages.title: Unscrew Them All
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Remove the screws holding wooden planks in Unscrew Them All. Move each screw into an open hole and watch how the planks shift as they come loose. Keep a slot free for your next move and get all the planks off before the timer expires.

pages.title: Limousine Car Game Simulator
pages.creator: Best Free Games
pages.description: Drive a limousine through the city in Limousine Car Game Simulator. Get a feel for how the long car turns as you follow the route and pick up coins. Use your earnings to unlock more limousines to take out on the road.

pages.title: Nuts And Bolts Screw Puzzle
pages.creator: Depfov
pages.description: Move bolts into empty holes in Nuts And Bolts Screw Puzzle. Look at which boards each bolt holds and choose an order that lets the boards drop away. Keep enough holes free to move the remaining bolts and clear the whole layout.

pages.title: Harbor Operator
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Draw routes to the correct docks in Harbor Operator. Guide yachts, tankers, and container ships in while accounting for their speed and how long they take to unload. Check the paths of other vessels before drawing a new route so the ships can pass safely.

pages.title: Taxi Driver Simulator
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Follow the blue directions to pick up and drop off passengers in Taxi Driver Simulator. Aim for three stars across 80 Work Mode levels and put your earnings toward more cars. In Free mode you can keep taking fares without advancing levels, with stops at gas stations to refuel.

pages.title: Design With Me SuperHero Tutu Outfits
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Put together superhero-inspired tutu outfits in Design With Me SuperHero Tutu Outfits. Choose a look for each princess before the fashion event. Try different combinations to give each outfit its own style while keeping the superhero theme.

pages.title: Club Tycoon: Idle Clicker
pages.creator: 7thReactor
pages.description: Run and defend a small club in Club Tycoon: Idle Clicker. Earn money and gather resources to upgrade your abilities as enemies test your defenses. Decide where each upgrade will help most, then see how your score compares on the leaderboard.

pages.title: Bouncing Chick
pages.creator: Catom Games
pages.description: Bounce a chick up to its nest in Bouncing Chick. Find a way past obstacles as you climb each level and watch for hazards near the next landing. There are 24 levels, and you can try for a quicker time on each climb.

pages.title: Goods Master 3D
pages.creator: BPTop
pages.description: Make groups of three matching products in Goods Master 3D. Sort snacks, drinks, and fruit in the cupboards, checking what you can reach before moving an item. Clear sets to make room and unlock more products as you go.

pages.title: Shoot & Bounce
pages.creator: Momo Games
pages.description: Shoot balls to raise their value in Shoot & Bounce. Use the money you earn to buy guns and merge them into stronger ones. Decide which weapons to upgrade as you work toward the earnings needed to finish each level.

pages.title: Random Cards Tower Defense
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Choose which cards to play against each wave in Random Cards Tower Defense. Check what each card can do and improve the ones you rely on as the battles get tougher. Build a team for the defense scenarios or take on a one-on-one opponent.

pages.title: The Dandy
pages.creator: Freak X Games
pages.description: Tap to keep Dandy from falling in The Dandy. Watch for obstacles along the route and keep Dandy moving safely past them. See how far you can get on each attempt as you try to improve your score.

pages.title: Snowball Dash
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Steer a snowball left and right in Snowball Dash. Dodge the pine trees and adjust your path as the snowball grows. The bigger it gets, the more room you need to leave as you roll toward the next opening.

pages.title: Original Classic Solitaire
pages.creator: AGED STUDIO LIMITED
pages.description: Sort the cards into foundations in Original Classic Solitaire. Move cards between the columns to uncover the ones underneath and use the draw pile when you need another option. Pick a background and use the time reminder if you want to keep track of your session.

pages.title: Racing Go
pages.creator: Wolves Interactive
pages.description: Weave between cars and trucks in Racing Go. Look for openings on the highway and slip between lanes to earn points. Traffic keeps coming in the endless mode, so watch the next group of vehicles before committing to a gap.

pages.title: Sheep Sheep!
pages.creator: HolaStudio
pages.description: Clear the tiles in Sheep Sheep! by looking for matching pieces as the board opens up. Plan what to pick before moving a tile and use the available props or hints if you're stuck. Work through the obstacles to finish each layout.

pages.title: Fortune Cookie
pages.creator: Brutal Dack Games
pages.description: Crack open fortune cookies to see the predictions inside in Fortune Cookie. Enter the merge game when you want more cookies, and complete its tasks as you go. Compare your progress with other players while you build up more fortunes to read.

pages.title: Dinogen Online
pages.creator: Wilkin Games
pages.description: Fight as a human or dinosaur in Dinogen Online. Pick a map and try a competitive match or team up with friends in a co-op mode. The top-down view lets you track nearby opponents as you work with the weapons available to your side.

pages.title: Bare Ball
pages.creator: NaminiStudio
pages.description: Bounce a ball into bricks in Bare Ball. Keep the ball from dropping past the paddle while you work through the layout. Try Classic, Double, or 1024, or play the unlimited mode for a high score. Complete challenges to unlock more levels.

pages.title: Canoniac Launcher Xmas
pages.creator: Garbuz Studio
pages.description: Launch a robot from a cannon in Canoniac Launcher Xmas. Try to send it far enough to reach Santa, using weapons and bombs to extend the flight. Spend the cash you earn on better equipment and see how much farther your next launch goes.

pages.title: Pig Ball Christmas
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Guide a round pig through a world of square animals in Pig Ball Christmas. Fight monsters and collect points as you cross each stage. The routes get longer and the monsters get tougher, so keep moving toward the final level.

pages.title: Jumper Starman
pages.creator: Hermit Crab Game Studio
pages.description: Help a stranded alien get back to his ship in Jumper Starman. Jump through six environments, using the ability to float when you need more time in the air. Watch for enemies and keep an eye on the clock as you climb.

pages.title: Brick Surfer
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Collect bricks as you run in Brick Surfer. Use the bricks under your feet to cross stretches of dangerous ground, and watch the route for places where you can pick up more. Carry more bricks through the run to earn more diamonds.

pages.title: HeroBall Christmas Love
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Guide a red ball through holiday courses in HeroBall Christmas Love. Get past dangerous obstacles and enemies as you try to rescue the ball's girlfriend. Work toward achievements and see how your score compares in the player rankings.

pages.title: Fruit Slice
pages.creator: BPTop
pages.description: Slice fruit and make drinks in Fruit Slice. Follow the preparation steps to turn the fruit into juice, then serve the flavor the customer wants. Work through different recipes as more drinks come up.

pages.title: Bird Flying
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Tap to keep a bird in the air in Bird Flying. Adjust its height as you approach each obstacle, then guide it through the opening. Keep looking ahead as the landscape changes and see how far you can fly.

pages.title: Princess Mermaid Style Makeup
pages.creator: babygames.com
pages.description: Help Ariel get ready to host a mermaid party in Princess Mermaid Style Makeup. Choose mermaid outfits and makeup for Elsa, Moana, Rapunzel, and Ariel. Try a different combination on each friend before the party begins.

pages.title: Eagle Coloring Book
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Choose an eagle drawing in Eagle Coloring Book and fill it with colors you like. Work on the larger shapes first or start with the smaller details. Try another palette or picture when you want a new design.

pages.title: Stack Twist 2
pages.creator: Gamearcade.org
pages.description: Send a ball down a tower of spinning platforms in Stack Twist 2. Break through colored sections and avoid the black ones during a normal fall. Build up speed to turn the ball into a fireball that can smash through black sections too.

pages.title: Jet Boi
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Knock your opponent off the roof in Jet Boi. Keep your own character on the rooftop while you try to push the other one over the edge. Play against the computer or share the game with a friend in local two-player mode.

pages.title: Modern City Bus Driving Simulator New Games 2020
pages.creator: hitNrun games
pages.description: Drive a city coach in Modern City Bus Driving Simulator New Games 2020. Get used to steering the long bus around urban streets as you work through the driving tasks. Try a different mode to see how the coach handles in another situation.

pages.title: Sweet Kitty Memory Challenge
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Flip cards to reveal pictures of Hello Kitty in Sweet Kitty Memory Challenge. Remember where each image appeared so you can find its match later. Clear the board by pairing up the pictures as you uncover them.

pages.title: School Mahjong Deluxe
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Find matching school items in School Mahjong Deluxe. Look for tiles with at least two neighboring sides open before selecting a pair. Take pairs that expose more of the layout, then work through the tiles that were blocked at the start.

pages.title: Building New House
pages.creator: babygames.com
pages.description: Run a handyman's workshop in Building New House. Fill customer orders by digging, cutting wood, welding, or putting together structures. Switch between building and demolition jobs as you work on houses, towers, and smaller wooden projects.

pages.title: Jump and Splat
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Tap to slam a bouncing ball down in Jump and Splat. Watch for a platform beneath it and time the drop so the ball lands safely. Keep bouncing from one landing to the next and see how far you can go.

pages.title: Jumpers Isometric HTML5
pages.creator: YAKPI
pages.description: Jump past obstacles as you run in Jumpers Isometric HTML5. Watch where your character will land and pick up coins along the way. Time each leap to clear the obstruction and keep moving toward the next coin.

pages.title: Muddy Village Car Stunt
pages.creator: Hitgames.org
pages.description: Drive a Beetle, M4, Mustang GT, or Camaro in Muddy Village Car Stunt. Try drifting in the arena or tackle the obstacles on muddy roads. Collect points as you work out which car suits the route and the stunts you want to try.

pages.title: Word Puzz
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Choose letters to spell the word in Word Puzz. Look at the clue on the board and the number of spaces you need to fill. Pick the letters in the order they belong, then try the next word as you work through the levels.

pages.title: Truck Hidden Cargo
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Find ten hidden cargo boxes in each picture in Truck Hidden Cargo. You get 50 seconds to search, and a wrong click can cost five seconds. Scan the scene carefully before clicking a box so you keep enough time to find the rest.

pages.title: Air Warfare 3D
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Fly against computer-controlled aircraft in Air Warfare 3D. Track enemy planes as they turn and line up a missile shot when you have an opening. Use the weapons at your disposal to work through three aerial combat missions.

pages.title: Lil Puppy Memory
pages.creator: Shunda Inc
pages.description: Flip tiles to reveal puppy pictures in Lil Puppy Memory. Remember where each puppy appears and match the two copies to clear them. Work through four levels and see whether you can finish each board in fewer moves.

pages.title: Candy Match Saga
pages.creator: Aningame
pages.description: Make groups of three matching candies in Candy Match Saga. Look across the board for pieces you can bring together and clear them. Check how the remaining sweets shift after each match to find another group.

pages.title: Hero Stunt Spider Bike Simulator 3d
pages.creator: gamesfog
pages.description: Pick a motorbike and ride through stunt courses in Hero Stunt Spider Bike Simulator 3d. Build speed for tricks and see how the bike handles as you land. Take on missions or use the space to practice the stunts you want to try.

pages.title: Helix Jump Halloween
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Guide a bouncing ball down a Halloween-themed tower in Helix Jump Halloween. Turn the helix to line up gaps beneath the ball, then let it drop through the openings. Watch how the next platform lines up as you descend.

pages.title: Cool Cars Memory
pages.creator: Shunda Inc
pages.description: Turn over cards to reveal cars in Cool Cars Memory. Remember where each vehicle appears and use that information to find its partner. There are four boards to clear, and you can try to finish them with fewer flips.

pages.title: BFF Feather Festival Fashion
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Dress Emma and Bonnie for the festival in BFF Feather Festival Fashion. Choose outfits and feathered accessories for each friend. Try different pieces together so the two looks suit the same event while giving each character her own style.

pages.title: Fish World Match3
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Connect at least three matching fish in Fish World Match3. Look for a group you can link and clear it to change the layout. Check the fish left on the board before making your next connection.

pages.title: 3d Racing Extreme
pages.creator: pogames.in
pages.description: Drive through a city full of obstacles in 3d Racing Extreme. Get to each mission objective before time runs out and earn money along the way. Buy a faster car with your earnings and see whether it helps you finish the next job sooner.

pages.title: Mini Tank Wars
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Drive a tank into combat in Mini Tank Wars. Try Team Deathmatch or switch to the other mode when you want a different fight. Look for ammunition, health, or shield power-ups as you maneuver around enemy tanks.

pages.title: Reach Fifty
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Slide numbers together to make sums of 50 in Reach Fifty. Move pieces horizontally or vertically, checking what they will add up to before combining them. A piece freezes when it reaches 50, so leave a route for the numbers you still need to group.

pages.title: Cartoon Animals Puzzle
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Put together pictures of cartoon animals in Cartoon Animals Puzzle. Pick easy, medium, or hard and use the edges and picture details to work out where the pieces fit. There's no timer, so you can spend as long as you like on each image.

pages.title: Cake Eaters
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Protect the cakes from incoming enemies in Cake Eaters. Aim at the face eaters before they get to the desserts and keep watching for more targets as they approach. Clear them out to save the cakes.

pages.title: Labo 51
pages.creator: Gamebuilt.com
pages.description: Leap between rotating wheels in Labo 51. Wait until the next wheel is in reach, then jump before the rising liquid catches you. Look for the next place to land as you climb through the machinery toward the top.

pages.title: Wild Animals Jigsaw
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Assemble pictures of wild animals in Wild Animals Jigsaw. Choose easy, medium, or hard and look for pieces that share an edge or part of the animal. Take your time with each picture, since the game has no countdown.

pages.title: Logical Theatre Nums
pages.creator: Rumata Lab
pages.description: Answer arithmetic questions in Logical Theatre Nums. Work out each calculation and choose the result before time runs out. Keep your attention on the numbers when performers cross the stage, and see how your speed and accuracy affect your score.

pages.title: Shot Pong
pages.creator: T
pages.description: Slide the paddle left and right in Shot Pong. Watch where the ball is headed and move the paddle beneath it before it falls past you. Keep returning the ball and see how long you can build up your score.

pages.title: Tomolo Bike
pages.creator: Tomolo Games
pages.description: Guide a bike all the way to the goal in Tomolo Bike. Keep it balanced over the changing track and be ready to adjust when the wheels lift off. Work through the courses by finding a safe way to roll over each obstacle.

pages.title: Dark Ninja
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Cross a rocky village and fight red ninjas in Dark Ninja. Run, jump, dash, or use the parachute to get through the terrain, then throw shuriken or turn invisible when enemies get close. Pick up ninja coins for points and potions to restore energy.

pages.title: Ella Makeup Removal
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Help Queen Ella get ready for bed in Ella Makeup Removal. Work through her evening routine after a busy day, starting with taking off her makeup. Get her comfortable for the night with pajamas and her favorite stuffed toy.

pages.title: Fall Ball
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Steer a ball down a sloping course in Fall Ball. Watch the platforms ahead and line up with the next safe section before you reach it. Keep away from the edges and see how long you can stay on the course.

pages.title: Snake Game
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Guide a growing snake around the board in Snake Game. Try Survival mode to see how long you can keep it going, or choose Adventure and work through 20 levels. Look ahead before turning so you have room to move as the snake grows.

pages.title: Christmas Preparations
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Help the princess get ready for Christmas in Christmas Preparations. Decorate the house and trim the tree, then choose an outfit from her holiday wardrobe. Try different decorations and clothes until you have the setting you want for the evening.

pages.title: Teen Princesses Nightlife
pages.creator: Games Banner Network
pages.description: Get Elsa and Aurora ready to go out in Teen Princesses Nightlife. Try outfits from their wardrobes and choose a hairstyle and accessories to go with each one. Give both princesses a look for the party.

pages.title: Bowling Ball
pages.creator: Cosmity
pages.description: Use three balls to knock down three pins in Bowling Ball. Aim each shot at the pins still standing and clear the set to win a gold medal. Earn five gold medals to unlock another ball.

pages.title: Ice Princess Makeup Time
pages.creator: Daria Games
pages.description: Choose a makeup combination in Ice Princess Makeup Time. Try the products in the princess's room until you have the look you want. Then pick an outfit, add accessories, and choose a hairstyle to finish it.

pages.title: Princess Dede Sweet Cake Decor
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Decorate a cake with Princess Dede in Princess Dede Sweet Cake Decor. Pick a flavor and cream, then choose sweets for the top. Try different combinations to see how the colors and decorations change the finished cake.
